host.description: The destination hostname or IP address to trace.

protocol_family.description: IP protocol version: '4' for IPv4 or '6' for IPv6.

max_hops.description: Maximum number of hops (TTL value) to probe.

queries_per_hop.description: Number of probe packets sent per hop.

simultaneous_queries.description: Number of probe packets sent simultaneously.

wait_time.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for a response to a probe.

source_address.description: Alternative source address to use. Empty string means auto-select.

interface.description: Network interface to send packets out of. Empty string means auto-select.

destination_port.description: Destination port. Base port for UDP, constant port for TCP, sequence start for ICMP.

source_port.description: Source port to use. 0 means let the system choose.

disable_dns.description: If true, do not resolve IP addresses to host names (-n).

no_fragment.description: If true, do not fragment probe packets (-F).

tos.description: Type of Service (IPv4) or Traffic Control (IPv6) value.

send_wait.description: Minimal time interval between probes in seconds.

packet_length.description: Size of probing packet. 0 uses default (60 for IPv4, 80 for IPv6).

fwmark.description: Firewall mark for outgoing packets. 0 means no mark.
